{{Quote|I mean, we're not talking Svivren here, but even Ukio should have taken them [the Galactic Empire] a little longer to overrun.|Samuel Tomas Gillespee|<ref name="Last Command" />}}
The '''Siege of Svivren''' took place in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]]. It involved the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces sent by [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Grand Admiral Thrawn]] against [[Svivreni resistance|the locals of]] the planet [[Svivren/Legends|Svivren]]. The Imperials were unable to win that fight

==History==
In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] attacked Svivren and several other worlds aligned to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The Imperial Navy was opposed by the locals, the [[Svivreni]] species, who disliked very much the idea of being sieged.<ref name="SB">''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]'', repeated in ''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref> This caught the Imperials flat-footed. After several failed attempts against the Svivreni resistance, the Imperial Navy retreated,<ref name="geo">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> only to return later and try to occupy Svivren. For a long time, the Imperials were unsuccessful at fighting the local resistance,<ref name="SB" /> and their plight was well-known enough to have reached the ears of [[Samuel Tomas Gillespee]], by then living at [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]].<ref name="Last Command" />

Eventually, after Thrawn's death in the [[Battle of Bilbringi (9 ABY)|Battle of Bilbringi]], the Imperials retreated from Svivren. As a consequence of their fight, the Svivreni decided that their resolution was as good as a military-grade weapon, and decided to be even more determined about rejecting invaders.<ref name="SB" />
